Sourcesrc/website\public\wasm\burn\luiskr_burn.js
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

Burn

Public wasm surface — one burn canvas per instance (the mosaic mounts one per title interaction).

begin

begin — start a sim session: dir +1 burns, −1 rebuilds; origin is the widget's CSS-px offset inside the canvas; seed makes the xorshift deterministic per session.

  • @param dir +1.0 burn / −1.0 rebuild.
  • @param ox Widget origin X, canvas CSS px.
  • @param oy Widget origin Y, canvas CSS px.
  • @param seed Deterministic xorshift seed (0 → session default).
  • @param {number} dir
  • @param {number} ox
  • @param {number} oy
  • @param {number} seed

frame

frame — one animation tick: advance the sim, emit instances, upload, draw. Per-frame cost: O(particles) scalar math + one instance write + one draw(6, n) — one JS→wasm crossing total.

  • @param dt Seconds since the previous call.
  • @param {number} dt

init

init — device + pipeline + buffers. Rejection → JS keeps the 2D-canvas burn; mounting can never regress the page.

  • @param canvas The widget's dedicated canvas.
  • @param device The shared GPUDevice (one per page, from the JS bridge).
  • @returns Ok on a live surface, Err(JsValue) on failure.
  • @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
  • @param {GPUDevice} device

live_particles

live_particles — the sim's live-particle count. The JS loop polls this for its settle check: the burn canvas can idle once the front is spent AND the last ember died (mirroring the JS sim's particles.length === 0 condition).

  • @returns Live particle count (0 when no sim is mounted).
  • @returns {number}

constructor

Burn::new — un-initialized surface; init must follow.

resize

resize — canvas-bitmap change → surface re-configure.

  • @param _w Device-pixel width (element-side).
  • @param _h Device-pixel height.
  • @param {number} _w
  • @param {number} _h

set_colors

set_colors — the ember ramp + scorch tint: [core, mid, edge, scorch] × rgba = 16 f32s.

  • @param flat Flat f32 color table.
  • @param {Float32Array} flat

set_dir

set_dir — +1 burn, −1 rebuild.

  • @param dir Direction discriminant.
  • @param {number} dir

set_ink

set_ink — per-column ink occupancy bytes (the front's paper mask — where burn front edges can live).

  • @param ink One byte per pixel-column.
  • @param {Uint8Array} ink

set_letters

set_letters — the letter table: 6 f32s per glyph (rect + speeds — see sim::BurnSim::set_letters for the exact layout).

  • @param flat Flat f32 letter table.
  • @param {Float32Array} flat

set_origin

set_origin — move the burn origin (the widget rect moved).

  • @param ox New origin X, canvas CSS px.
  • @param oy New origin Y, canvas CSS px.
  • @param {number} ox
  • @param {number} oy

set_size

set_size — the canvas's CSS-pixel size (viewport uniform).

  • @param w Canvas width in CSS pixels.
  • @param h Canvas height in CSS pixels.
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

set_stage

set_stage — per-frame stage + jagged amplitude pushed by the bridge before frame.

  • @param stage Global burn progress 0..1.
  • @param jag_amp Jagged-edge amplitude in px.
  • @param {number} stage
  • @param {number} jag_amp
